title: 1 Pa. Code § 3.11. Bulletin constitutes official gazette.
text:
BULLETIN
§ 3.11. Bulletin constitutes official gazette.
Section 724 of 45 Pa.C.S. (relating to preliminary publication in Pennsylvania Bulletin ) provides that the Bulletin is the official gazette of the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania.
Cross References
This section cited in 1 Pa. Code § 9.301 (relating to unpublished statements of policy adopted prior to January 1, 1985).
